title: Text editors
description:
Time for you to finally set up a _real_ local development environment. Few devs actually codes in their terminal (me, other vim users, emacs users, etc.), they just install a IDE which is just a text editor with some QOL stuff and a terminal. This is where VSCode comes in. It is a "fairly" small text editor (in the IDE realm. Compared to any terminal editor other than maybe EMacs, it's the size of the sun, and the others are the size of a neutron star.) and is the most popular with devs today.
A few other good GUI edtiors are:
- [IntelliJ IDEA](https://www.jetbrains.com/idea/)
- [Zed](https://zed.dev)
And some good terminal editors are
- [Emacs](https://www.gnu.org/software/emacs/)
- [Vim](https://www.vim.org)
- [Neovim (I use this one)](https://neovim.io)
---
## Assignment:
If you don't already have a editor you like, install [VSCode Here](https://code.visualstudio.com), or if you know how to use vim/nvim or are willing to learn, I heavily implore you to install [NeoVim Here](https://neovim.io).
